Decisions on this page (each with its default and its source on hover) The real-time column is the newest interval each operator has published for the node, read every 15 minutes, so a price can be up to about half an hour old when the page is read. (session 10) i [tip] Default: The newest published interval, refreshed every 15 minutes. Source: The operators' real-time market data, read by the 15-minute loop (warehouse/connectors/latest_prices.py). ERCOT's real-time figure is its 15-minute settlement point price; the other grids' are 5-minute locational prices, as each operator publishes them, never averaged to a common interval. (session 10) i [tip] Default: Each operator's own interval: 15 minutes for ERCOT, 5 for the others. Source: ERCOT's settlement point prices; CAISO's, NYISO's, MISO's, SPP's and ISO-NE's real-time LMPs. The day-ahead column is the hour that contains the time the page was drawn; where the table holds no such row, the cell says what it holds instead, its newest hour for the node or that it holds none of the last day. (sessions 319 and 351; the owner's ruling of 20 October 2026) i [tip] Default: The day-ahead hour containing the moment the page is drawn. Source: The operators' day-ahead market results; the owner's ruling of 20 October 2026 kept the column with these words. The page is drawn again at most every 15 minutes, so the day-ahead hour and the newest real-time interval are as of the last drawing, not of the moment a reader opens it. (session 11) i [tip] Default: Drawn again at most every 15 minutes. Source: The site's own rule (revalidate of 900 seconds), matching the 15-minute loop. PJM's prices are not shown: PJM licenses its market data for internal use only, so its grid is named and left without a figure. (session 11) i [tip] Default: PJM named, no figure. Source: PJM's terms for its market data, licensed for internal use only; docs/methods/power_prices.md, "The rules". A grid whose price tables need a license from 20 October 2026 shows no price; the license line under the title names it, and its rows wait for the publisher's permission. (session 215) i [tip] Default: NYISO's and ISO-NE's prices held; the license line says why. Source: warehouse/metadata/license_status.csv and the publishers' own terms of use, read for each table. MISO is paused since 4 October 2026: its terms forbid automated access, so no request goes to MISO and its rows are those held before the pause, or none. (session 89) i [tip] Default: No request to MISO; what is held stays. Source: MISO's terms of use; docs/methods/miso_pause.md. A hub's or zone's price stands for an average over many points of a grid; the price at one site differs from it by congestion and losses, and no figure of the page is priced at a node. (session 328) i [tip] Default: Hubs and zones only, never a node. Source: The operators' hub and zone definitions; docs/methods/power_prices.md, "The rules". Download the tables: every public table is on Data and methods . Related: Price board , Supply and trade
